current_difficulty_reason: A scalar elliptic parametrix does not control the different harmonic and perpendicular boundary asymptotics of the fibered-boundary Laplacian. Section5 introduces an extended fiber-diagonal calculus, constructs the block approximation and corrects its indicial behavior before removing the enlarged interior singularity. The source then iterates to the exact left/right remainder classes, retaining the specified index sets after standard pseudodifferential foundations are allowed.
